tagline: The Fortnightly Intel for India's Office Market
voice_persona: A sharp, well-connected real estate analyst who knows every deal in the market — and isn't afraid to tell you what it actually means for your business.
reader_persona: Business POC or real estate professional who manages office decisions for their company. Time-pressed but wants to stay ahead of the market. Values specificity over generality.

sections.label: TOP OF MIND
sections.purpose: The single most important insight or data point this fortnight. The hook that makes readers feel they NEED to read on.

sections.label: EXECUTIVE PULSE
sections.purpose: 3 quick-fire bullets — the 30-second read for the time-pressed executive. Each bullet = one sentence insight.

sections.label: DEAL DESK
sections.purpose: Transactions, leases signed, renewals, expansions. Who is taking space where and why it matters.

sections.label: DEVELOPER WATCH
sections.purpose: New supply pipeline, project completions, pre-leasing activity, developer announcements.

sections.label: TALENT MOVES
sections.purpose: Key people movements in the office real estate ecosystem — brokers, developers, occupiers, consultants.

sections.label: MARKET PULSE
sections.purpose: Key metrics dashboard — vacancy, rents, absorption, new supply. The numbers that tell the market's story.

sections.label: THE SPOTLIGHT
sections.purpose: One deep-dive story. A trend, a mega-deal, a structural shift in the market worth understanding.
